About

A gaming-technology student who ships playable things, not just prototypes.

I'm a third-year Computer Science student at VIT Bhopal, specializing in Gaming Technology. Almost everything I build starts in Unity — driving physics, player controllers, VR interaction, level design, shaders — because I'd rather build the system a player moves through than the page they read.

Outside game dev I've picked up web development, cybersecurity and machine learning internships along the way — useful for building tools around my games, not a separate direction.

When I'm not at a keyboard, I'm usually on a Kabaddi or Sepak Takraw court — I compete at national and state level in a handful of sports.
